addresses.description: Default I2C address when SDO pin is left floating or pulled-up to VDDIO
Alternate I2C address when SDO pin is pulled-down to GND

register_map.notes: Register addresses 0x00-0x28; auto-increment supported for multi-byte reads/writes.

read_channels.notes: 24-bit two's complement raw pressure; compensated to Pa using calibration coefficients.
24-bit two's complement raw temperature; compensated to degC using calibration coefficients.

registers_or_commands.name: PRS_B1
registers_or_commands.description: Middle byte of 24-bit 2's complement pressure data

registers_or_commands.name: TMP_B1
registers_or_commands.description: Middle byte of 24-bit 2's complement temperature data

registers_or_commands.name: PRS_CFG
registers_or_commands.description: Pressure measurement configuration: rate and oversampling

registers_or_commands.name: TMP_CFG
registers_or_commands.description: Temperature measurement configuration: sensor source, rate, oversampling

registers_or_commands.name: MEAS_CFG
registers_or_commands.description: Measurement configuration: mode and status bits

registers_or_commands.name: INT_STS
registers_or_commands.description: Interrupt status register, cleared on read

registers_or_commands.name: RESET
registers_or_commands.description: FIFO flush and soft reset register

bitfields.name: PM_RATE
bitfields.description: Pressure measurement rate in background mode: 000=1/s, 001=2/s, 010=4/s, 011=8/s, 100=16/s, 101=32/s, 110=64/s, 111=128/s

bitfields.name: TMP_RATE
bitfields.description: Temperature measurement rate in background mode: same encoding as PM_RATE

bitfields.name: TMP_RDY
bitfields.description: Temperature measurement ready, cleared when read

bitfields.name: PRS_RDY
bitfields.description: Pressure measurement ready, cleared when read

bitfields.name: MEAS_CTRL
bitfields.description: Measurement mode control: 000=standby, 001=pressure command, 010=temp command, 101=continuous pressure, 110=continuous temp, 111=continuous pressure and temp

bitfields.name: T_SHIFT
bitfields.description: Temperature result bit-shift: 0=no shift, 1=shift right. Must be set to 1 when oversampling >8x

bitfields.name: P_SHIFT
bitfields.description: Pressure result bit-shift: 0=no shift, 1=shift right. Must be set to 1 when oversampling >8x

init_sequence.notes: Power-up or soft reset: wait for SENSOR_RDY (max 12ms) and COEF_RDY (max 40ms).
Configure PRS_CFG, TMP_CFG, CFG_REG, and MEAS_CFG for desired mode (e.g., background continuous).

read_sequence.notes: Read 3 bytes of pressure raw data from 0x00.
Read 3 bytes of temperature raw data from 0x03.

timing_constraints.name: T_Sensor_rdy
timing_constraints.condition: After VDD>1.2V & VDDIO>0.6V or soft reset
timing_constraints.notes: Time to sensor ready (SENSOR_RDY bit set).

timing_constraints.name: T_Coef_rdy
timing_constraints.condition: After VDD>1.2V & VDDIO>0.6V or soft reset
timing_constraints.notes: Time to coefficients available (COEF_RDY bit set).

timing_constraints.name: I2C_data_setup_time
timing_constraints.notes: Data setup time on SDI pin.

timing_constraints.name: I2C_data_hold_time
timing_constraints.condition: Standard, fast, and high speed mode
timing_constraints.notes: Data hold time on SDI pin.

conversion_formulae.name: compensated_temperature
conversion_formulae.formula: T_raw_scaled = raw_temp / kT; T_comp = c0 * 0.5 + c1 * T_raw_scaled

inputs.name: kT
inputs.description: Scale factor based on temperature oversampling rate

conversion_formulae.name: compensated_pressure
conversion_formulae.formula: P_raw_scaled = raw_pres / kP; P_comp = c00 + P_raw_scaled * (c10 + P_raw_scaled * (c20 + P_raw_scaled * c30)) + T_raw_scaled * (c01 + P_raw_scaled * (c11 + P_raw_scaled * c21))

evidence_spans.snippet: The sensor's address is 0x77 (default) or 0x76 (if the SDO pin is pulled-down to GND).
Time to sensor ready T Sensor_rdy 12 ms
Time to coefficients are available. T Coef_rdy 40 ms
Read the pressure calibration coefficients (c00, c10, c20, c30, c01, c11, and c21) from the Calibration Coefficient register.
Read the temperature calibration coefficients ( c0 and c1 ) from the Calibration Coefficients (COEF) register.
Scale Factor (kP or kT) 524288 for single
Data setup time on SDI pin t Setup 20 ns S&F mode
Data hold time on SDI pin t Hold 0 ns S&F&HSmode

requires_human: The exact compensation formula details (scaled measurement and compensated results) are described in prose; the precise mathematical expressions need to be derived from the flow chart and equations.
The coefficient bitfield layout (e.g., c0 split across two registers) requires careful assembly of 2's complement numbers from non-contiguous bits.
The FIFO operation description indicates that the LSB of the 24-bit result is used to indicate measurement type when FIFO is enabled; this may affect data interpretation.
The interrupt polarity must be set opposite to SDO pin level when using I2C with interrupt; this is a system-level constraint.
